Lease.title: Lease Q&A
Lease.description: Ask about rent, deposit, notice period, or utilities. The API forwards the question to the Python extraction service.
Lease.defaultQuestion: What is the monthly rent and when is it due?

Assistant.welcomeBody: I can help you find a rental, understand how trust and verification work, or point you to lease answers.
Assistant.welcomeDisclaimer: I can't see private lease documents or confirm a listing's verification status in this chat.
Assistant.suggestion3: Can I ask questions about a lease?
Assistant.suggestion4: What can you help me with?
Assistant.composerHint: AI can make mistakes. Check listing details before deciding.
Assistant.greeting: Hi! I'm RentVision AI. Ask me about finding a rental, trust and verification, or lease questions.
Assistant.greetingAfter: Hi again! What would you like to explore next?
Assistant.searchIntro: I found {count, plural, one {# available match} other {# available matches}}.
Assistant.searchIntroNoFilters: Here are some available rentals from RentVision.
Assistant.searchNone: I couldn't find any available listings that match those filters.
Assistant.searchNoneHint: Try widening your budget, changing the neighborhood, or removing a filter.
Assistant.searchDemoNote: These results use the app's built-in demo listings, so they aren't live market data.
Assistant.leaseIntro: Lease answers come from the property's lease Q&A page, where you can ask about the document you're reviewing.
Assistant.leaseSteps: Open a property, choose its lease Q&A, then ask a specific question. Answers are grounded in the lease text and show page citations.
Assistant.leaseNoCurrent: You're not on a property page right now, so open a property first to use lease Q&A.
Assistant.trustIntro: RentVision is built to make rental decisions more transparent. Listings can show trust signals and verification status, and the platform is designed to surface duplicate or risky listings for review.
Assistant.trustNoClaims: I can't confirm that a specific listing is verified from this chat. Check the trust panel on the listing page for the status that applies to that property.
Assistant.helpTitle: Here's what I can help with:
Assistant.helpSearch: Finding rentals by neighborhood, budget, bedrooms, or property type.
Assistant.helpTrust: Explaining how trust signals and verification work on RentVision.
Assistant.helpLease: Pointing you to lease Q&A for the property you're viewing.
Assistant.helpGeneral: Answering general rental questions when the AI service is available.
Assistant.helpNote: I won't invent listings, prices, addresses, or lease terms. For property-specific details, use the listing or lease pages.
Assistant.aiErrorAuth: The AI assistant isn't configured on this deployment. Property search, trust guidance, and lease links still work.
Assistant.aiErrorTimeout: The assistant took too long to respond. Please try again.
Assistant.aiErrorRateLimit: The assistant is busy right now. Please wait a moment and try again.
Assistant.aiErrorBadRequest: The assistant couldn't process that message. Try rephrasing it.
Assistant.aiErrorEmpty: The assistant returned an empty answer. Please try again.
Assistant.aiErrorNetwork: I couldn't reach the assistant service. Check your connection and try again.
Assistant.aiErrorUpstream: The assistant service is unavailable right now. Please try again.
Assistant.aiErrorProvider: The assistant ran into a problem. Please try again.
Assistant.errorNetwork: Something went wrong while sending your message. Please try again.
Assistant.errorGeneric: I couldn't load property results right now. Please try again.
Assistant.messageLimit: This conversation is getting long. Clear it to start a new one.

Dashboard.title: Your rental portfolio
Dashboard.description: Track your listings, manage photos and tours, and keep property details up to date.
Dashboard.recentDescription: The properties you updated most recently.
Dashboard.emptyMessage: Create your first listing to add photos, a 360° tour, and the details renters need.
Dashboard.statusNote: Listing status is shown exactly as the RentVision API reports it. This portal cannot mark a property as approved, verified, or published on its own.

Properties.title: Your properties
Properties.description: Review every listing in your portfolio and open one to update its details, photos, or tour.
Properties.emptyMessage: Add your first property to start building your RentVision portfolio.
Properties.noMatchesMessage: Try a different status filter or clear your search to see more listings.

Property.notFoundMessage: This property could not be found in your portfolio. It may have been removed or you may not have access to it.
Property.savedMessage: Your listing details and any media updates were saved. The status below is the status returned by RentVision.
Property.statusNote: This is the status returned by the RentVision API. Moderation, verification, and publishing controls are not available in this portal.
Property.approvedNote: Approved means the API reports this listing as visible to renters. It is not a verification or quality guarantee.
Property.roomsValue: {bedrooms, plural, one {# bedroom} other {# bedrooms}} · {bathrooms, plural, one {# bathroom} other {# bathrooms}}
Property.mediaHint: Previews use short-lived signed URLs. The underlying files stay private in storage.
Property.mediaEmpty: No photos have been uploaded for this listing yet.
Property.tourHint: Scene previews are loaded with signed URLs. The tour viewer itself is available on the public listing page.
Property.tourEmpty: No 360° tour has been saved for this listing.
Property.manageNoteTitle: What this portal does not do
Property.manageNote: Inquiries, moderation decisions, verification badges, duplicate checks, and portfolio analytics are not connected to the API yet, so this portal does not pretend to offer them.

Inquiries.title: Renter inquiries
Inquiries.description: Messages from prospective renters will appear here when the API supports them.
Inquiries.unavailableMessage: The RentVision API does not currently expose a messaging or inquiry endpoint for landlords. This portal does not display placeholder conversations or invented renter details.
Inquiries.whatYouCanDo: Until messaging is connected, renters can contact you using the details published with your listing. Keep your listing information accurate so they can reach you.
Inquiries.note: When an inquiry API is available, this page can be connected without changing the rest of the landlord portal.

Settings.title: Account settings
Settings.description: Review the account currently signed in to the landlord portal.
Settings.localDevNote: Local development authentication is active because Cognito is not configured and the web app is pointed at a local API. Production uses Cognito.
Settings.unavailableMessage: The RentVision API does not currently expose landlord profile update endpoints. This portal shows your signed-in account as read-only rather than saving changes that would not persist.
Settings.securityNote: Password, email, and sign-in details are managed by the configured authentication provider. Use the provider's account recovery flow if you need to change them.

Wizard.createDescription: Work through the steps to describe the property, add photos, and optionally build a 360° tour.
Wizard.editDescription: Update the listing details, media, and tour. Changes are saved to RentVision when you submit the review step.
Wizard.draftNotice: Draft details are stored only in this browser until the listing is created. Selected photos and tour scenes are not kept in the draft.
Wizard.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields before continuing.
Wizard.acceptRequired: Confirm that the listing details are accurate before saving.
Wizard.saveFailed: The listing could not be saved. Please try again.
Wizard.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded.
Wizard.partialMessage: The listing details were saved, but the following media could not be added. Retry to upload the remaining files.
Wizard.tourNotSaved: The tour metadata could not be saved. Retry to finish adding the tour.
Wizard.loadError: The listing could not be loaded.

Basics.title: Property basics
Basics.description: Start with the information renters see first: a clear title, description, rent, and property type.
Basics.titleHint: Use 5–120 characters. Mention the neighborhood if it helps.
Basics.descriptionHint: At least 30 characters. Describe the layout, condition, and what makes the property a good home.
Basics.descriptionPlaceholder: Bright apartment with an open living area, secure parking, and a backup water tank…

Location.title: Where is the property?
Location.description: Enter the address and coordinates. Renters use this to understand the neighborhood and search on the map.
Location.mapTitle: Pick the location on the map
Location.mapHint: Click the map to move the marker, or edit the coordinates above.
Location.mapUnavailable: Enter valid coordinates to use the map picker. The address fields still work without it.

Details.title: Rooms and amenities
Details.description: Add the practical details renters compare when choosing a home.
Details.amenitiesHint: Select everything that applies, or add your own.

Photos.title: Property photos
Photos.description: Upload clear photos. The first photo is used as the cover image on search results.
Photos.dropHint: Drag and drop images here, or use the button above.
Photos.limits: Up to {count} photos. JPEG, PNG, or WebP, maximum 50 MB each.
Photos.coverHint: The first photo becomes the cover.
Photos.emptyMessage: Add at least one photo before continuing. You can reorder by removing and re-adding photos.

Panorama.title: 360° virtual tour
Panorama.description: Upload equirectangular 360° images, arrange the scenes, and connect them with hotspots.
Panorama.requirement: Images must be JPEG, PNG, or WebP with an approximately 2:1 width-to-height aspect ratio. Images below 2048 px wide are accepted with a resolution warning.
Panorama.cannotVerify: The aspect ratio check cannot prove that an image is a genuine 360° capture. Only upload panoramas you have the right to publish.
Panorama.removeExisting: Remove the existing 360° tour from this listing
Panorama.removedMessage: Saving will clear the tour metadata and scene keys from the listing.
Panorama.emptyMessage: This step is optional. Add a 2:1 equirectangular image to start a tour, or continue without one.
Panorama.hotspotsHint: Add a hotspot to show information or move to another scene. Coordinates are pitch (-90 to 90) and yaw (-180 to 180).

Review.title: Review and save
Review.description: Check the details below, then save the listing. Media uploads happen after the listing record is saved.
Review.rooms: {bedrooms, plural, one {# bedroom} other {# bedrooms}} · {bathrooms, plural, one {# bathroom} other {# bathrooms}}
Review.publishNotice: RentVision decides the listing status. This portal does not mark listings as published or verified; the status shown after saving comes from the API.
Review.verificationNotice: Verification, duplicate detection, and moderation outcomes are not available in this portal yet.
Review.confirm: I confirm these listing details are accurate and I have the right to publish this media.
